_comment: Scenario battery for Village Remedies' clinic-specific node_6b (claude-haiku-4-5, Override: Disabled). This file is the older numbered-step architecture (not the shared FAMILY LOOKUP GATE/KNOWN FAST-PATH design) — see .claude/rules/node6_post_booking_name_correction_bug.md for why this clinic's node_6b never received the 2026-08-17 post-booking name-correction fix that shipped to nodes/shared/node_6b_name_collection_other.txt. Scenarios here verify the ## AFTER BOOKING SUCCEEDS block added 2026-08-20, adapted from the shared file's PBN1/PBN2 scenarios, plus one regression check on the pre-existing EXECUTE flow (step 5) to confirm the new section didn't disturb it.

scenarios.name: PBN1 — Post-booking name correction, single field (first name), patient_id from book result

history.content: I'd like to book my son in for physio.
What is their full name?
Peter Novak
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "capture_context", "success": true, "patient_name_raw": "Peter Novak"}
I'll put your number on Peter's record — is that right, or do they have their own?
Yes, use mine.
I need an email address to complete the booking. Please tell me their full email address.
They don't have one.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Peter's confirmed for Thursday at 4 PM with Dr Lee.", "patient": {"id": "91207", "first_name": "Peter", "last_name": "Novak", "email": ""}}
Peter's confirmed for Thursday at 4 PM with Dr Lee.
Actually, it's spelled Peader, not Peter — P, E, A, D, E, R.
So that's Peader, P, E, A, D, E, R — is that right?
Yes, that's it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase (e.g. 'Checking that now, one moment.') AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='update_contact_detail' with patient_id='91207' (the patient.id from the most recent smart_voice_agent book result — the family member's record, not the caller's own), field='first_name', value='Peader'. FAIL if patient_id is omitted (would incorrectly fall back to a caller-phone lookup and update the CALLER's own record instead of Peter/Peader's). FAIL if the agent only acknowledges the correction verbally with no tool call. FAIL if field='full_name' (only the first name changed). FAIL if the agent instead re-enters step 0 FAMILY LOOKUP GATE / step 1 NAME or otherwise ignores the correction.

scenarios.name: PBN2 — Post-booking name correction, both fields (full name)

history.content: Can you book my daughter in, Sarah Jonson.
What's a good number to reach Sarah on?
Yes.
I need an email address to complete the booking. Please tell me their full email address.
sarah dot jonson at gmail dot com
So that's sarah.jonson@gmail.com. Is that correct?
Yes.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Sarah's confirmed for Monday at 10 AM with Dr Patel.", "patient": {"id": "55810", "first_name": "Sarah", "last_name": "Jonson", "email": "sarah.jonson@gmail.com"}}
Sarah's confirmed for Monday at 10 AM with Dr Patel.
Sorry, you've got her name wrong — it's actually Sara Johnson, no H in Sara and with an H in Johnson.
So that's S, A, R, A, Johnson with an H — Johnson — is that right?
Yes, that's correct.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='update_contact_detail' with patient_id='55810', field='full_name', value='Sara Johnson' (one call, both parts changed). FAIL if patient_id is omitted or wrong. FAIL if field is 'first_name' or 'last_name' only (both parts changed here). FAIL if two separate tool calls are made instead of one. FAIL if the correction is only acknowledged verbally with no tool call.

scenarios.name: REG1 — EXECUTE still fires normally when booking has not yet succeeded (no AFTER BOOKING SUCCEEDS interference)

history.content: I need to book for my son.
What is their full name?
Noah Williams
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "capture_context", "success": true, "patient_name_raw": "Noah Williams"}
I'll put your number on Noah's record — is that right, or do they have their own?
Yes, use mine.
I need an email address to complete the booking. Please tell me their full email address.
They don't have one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment' (or equivalent per step 5 EXECUTE) AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with booking_for='other'. No prior smart_voice_agent book success exists in history, so AFTER BOOKING SUCCEEDS must NOT fire and must not block or alter this turn. FAIL if the agent asks about a name correction, calls update_contact_detail, or otherwise references AFTER BOOKING SUCCEEDS logic. FAIL if the booking tool call is skipped or malformed.
